shared: Each player has a visible Moon cycling New, Waxing, Full, Waning, and Hares hit hardest at Full.
differ: They split on the Moon's job: a wipe you race, a dial you steer, or a clock you wind.

takes.label: Buffs with a shelf life
takes.line: Hares never keep stats: their Moonlight goes out each New Moon, so you double it with Chalk-Cutter, spike, then cash the loss.
takes.look_if: big timed spikes, and buffs that expire on a schedule.

takes.label: The Moon you steer
takes.line: Each Moon turn grows Hares for good; Dame Waxwell turns it twice or holds it, and Box starts brawls at fight start.
takes.look_if: a steady permanent engine and a Moon you steer each turn.

takes.label: The sell-wound clock
takes.line: Selling Hares like Old Wat winds the Moon, and at New Moon Grandam turns back-row Leverets into copies of the Hares ahead.
takes.look_if: to wind the Moon by selling, and copy your best Hares.
